title: See how people land on cubric.studio
description: Downloads jumped to ~400 Windows full zips a day (2.1.2: 1,720 in 4 days) but GitHub traffic cannot say from where: the cubric.studio download button links straight to the release asset, so GitHub sees ~15 page views a day and no referrer. The site promises 'No analytics' (footer, index.html:160) and has none. cubric.studio DNS is on Cloudflare (DNS only, not proxied; server is GitHub Pages). Repo: C:\AI\Mpi\Cubric Studio (Website) (no board there, so the card lives here). Options, cheapest first: (1) Google Search Console, verify by a DNS TXT record on Cloudflare: search terms, landing pages and clicks, no script, nothing on the visitor, keeps the promise. (2) Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon: cookieless, free, gives referrers, pages, countries; but it IS analytics, so the footer line and the privacy page must change first (Fabio's product call). (3) Orange-cloud the record so Cloudflare counts requests server-side: no script, but GitHub Pages HTTPS behind the proxy needs care, and zone analytics give totals, not per-visitor referrers. Fabio decides between (2) and nothing; (1) is a free first step. Also: ask the Discord 'how did you find us?'. Source session: Identity 2026-10-25.
